title: Axis-LoRA: Probing and Adapting Embedding Models for Personal-Memory Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.07820v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As LLMs are increasingly asked questions about a user's personal experiences, retrieval must distinguish memories by time, place, person, and event. Current personal-memory pipelines rely on frozen dense embedding models to embed memories for retrieval, but we find that these models do not capture the four axes well. Swapping a memory's date or place barely shifts its embedding, and a trained projection on top of the frozen embedding does not recover the missing signal. The problem lives inside the model, where each axis is encoded by a distinct attention-head pattern. Guided by these findings, we propose Axis-LoRA, a per-axis adapter that places four LoRA branches inside the embedding model and combines them via a per-query gate. Across three standard embedding models evaluated on LongMemEval, ATM-Bench, and LoCoMo, Axis-LoRA improves 4-benchmark mean R@10 by $+1.28$ to $+1.56$~pp while training only a small fraction of the base param

translated_title: Axis-LoRA：面向个人记忆检索的嵌入模型探测与适配
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型越来越多地被问及有关用户个人经历的问题，检索系统必须能够按时间、地点、人物和事件四个维度来区分记忆。当前的个人记忆处理流水线依赖冻结的稠密嵌入模型来嵌入记忆以供检索，但我们发现这些模型并不能很好地捕捉这四个维度：更换一条记忆的日期或地点几乎不会改变其嵌入向量，而在冻结嵌入之上训练的投影层也无法恢复缺失的信号。问题出在模型内部，其中每个维度由一种独特的注意力头模式进行编码。基于这些发现，我们提出了 Axis-LoRA，一种按维度设计的适配器，它在嵌入模型内部放置四个 LoRA 分支，并通过逐查询门控机制将它们组合起来。在 LongMemEval、ATM-Bench 和 LoCoMo 上对三个标准嵌入模型进行评估，Axis-LoRA 将四个基准的平均 R@10 提升了 1.28 至 1.56 个百分点，同时仅训练基础参数的一小部分。
tldr: 该论文发现冻结的稠密嵌入模型无法按时间、地点、人物、事件四个维度有效区分个人记忆，并提出 Axis-LoRA——在嵌入模型内部为每个维度设置 LoRA 分支并通过逐查询门控融合的适配方法，仅训练少量参数即可在三个记忆检索基准上显著提升性能。
en_tdlr: The paper finds that frozen dense embedding models fail to distinguish personal memories along the four axes of time, place, person, and event, and proposes Axis-LoRA, which inserts four per-axis LoRA branches inside the embedding model combined via a per-query gate, improving mean R@10 by 1.28-1.56 points across three benchmarks while training only a small fraction of the base parameters.
